tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: Read-only. Lists destinations currently exposed by Voya Homes. It never creates a booking, intention, payment, hold or customer record.

tools.name: search_homes
tools.description: Read-only search of vacation homes using destination, dates and guests. Returns current server-side availability, prices and links to continue on the Voya Homes property or checkout page. It never reserves, charges, creates an intention or sends a payment request.

tools.name: get_home
tools.description: Read-only property details and optional date-bound price. When dates and guests are supplied, returns a server-side availability result plus a direct checkout URL. It never reserves, charges, creates an intention or modifies data.

tools.name: find_homes
tools.description: Read-only static catalog discovery by property name, public code, condominium, neighborhood, city, bedrooms or amenities. It does not check date availability or return a fixed price; use search_homes after selecting travel dates.
